QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_51

question.text: Under SAS-1100, the PMAY (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana) beneficiary enrolment by the SE is reported as 23% of families. The SIA should verify this by:

answer.text: Checking the SE's own claim only
Cross-checking the pmaymis.gov.in database for the listed beneficiaries, sampled for match accuracy

explanation.text: The Logic: PMAY-MIS is the official public portal. Matching SE-provided beneficiary list against PMAY-MIS is the primary verification MoV under SAS-1100 for subsidy-enrolment claims. The Trap: Options A, C, B are uncorroborated. Cross-Exam Context: Govt-database matching also in XXIV AML (PAN / Aadhaar cross-check) and III-C Compliance. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Automate the PMAY match — a short Python script can match beneficiary Aadhaar/name against PMAY-MIS CSV in minutes and flag mismatches for manual review.
